run_loftr_matching: run LoFTR feature matching on HPatches dataset pairs and save keypoints to output HDF5 file
build_loftr_matcher: build a LoFTR matcher model from pretrained checkpoint with configurable default settings
transform_hpatch_images: transform HPatches image pairs through LoFTR to extract matched keypoints and confidence scores
cache_hpatches_dataset: cache HPatches dataset by applying LoFTR transform to each image pair and writing results to HDF5
load_loftr_weights: load LoFTR model weights from checkpoint file and configure inference mode on CUDA device
